intent: Component adapter over DatabaseClient with bound parameters, insert-only on the V1 and V2 tables: one query loads existing identities, one batch insert appends, payload through the pinned cipher. PB-06 timeout-budget: Mono.timeout(Duration). PB-13 bounded-page: every list query binds LIMIT :limit from the page keys, capped by the max. Step log revision.appended.

methods.semantics: count of rows appended; duplicates of the full identity (device, metric, t_device, value) are no-ops; same device, metric and t_device with a different value appends a CORRECTION revision

methods.signature: Flux<TelemetrySample> findByDeviceAndMetric(String deviceId, String metricKind, Instant from, Instant to)
methods.semantics: ordered by t_device ascending, capped at the configured page size
